title: Ines and the Border
author: Felix Ishikawa
blurb: Cyrus Zhou, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a dead handler sends a meeting invitation for tomorrow — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must get the truth past three governments and one assassin, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
